name: Weird Is Normal ~Fateful~
source:
Benkmann got an application from a person that he'd rather not even acknowledge existing, but at the same time it is such a brilliant writer that he feels guilty. So he could ask one of his subordinates to help him decide...or maybe just meet what he feared for so long.

[From [url=https://moonbyte.itch.io/weird-is-normal-fateful]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Benkmann收到了一份申请，申请人是一个他宁愿假装不存在的人；然而，对方又是一名才华横溢的作家，让他因此感到内疚。于是，他可以请一名下属帮忙决定……也可以亲自面对那个让他恐惧已久的人。

（来源：[url=https://moonbyte.itch.io/weird-is-normal-fateful]itch.io[/url]）
